reconciliation: All 11 Chullin and 12 Bava Kamma core source segments inspected across eight layer considerations. This is targeted source judgment, not exhaustive schema-conformant atomic annotation or completed tractate coverage.
Every core segment carries full exact evidence plus selected exact atomic spans. No production labels read or compared.

Omission-sensitive items: Chullin composite dialogue turns, quoted tannaim, הרי זו/הרי עלי condition, post-facto versus initially permitted, actor/observer scope, duplicated אבל; Bava Kamma repeated-liability conditions, Rabbi Eliezer role, split impurity list, Rav Pappa partial answer and context final specification.
Speaker assignments based on dialogue rather than explicit names are flagged inferential. Unresolved Maveh interpretation in core is not silently settled.
No silent attribution inversion or retraction identified in core; contextual Rava לדבריו דאביי explicitly cautioned. Exact occurrence counts preserved, no unique-topic count inferred.
